purpose: Bounded observed conversation repair validation, not model ranking or quality equivalence

steps: reply to exact synthetic tester interruption

interruption: 先插一句：比起走到車站近，我更在意晚上安靜。先用兩個虛構例子帶我看差異，告訴我看房時各要檢查什麼；現在不用再問我的完整條件。
acceptance: Useful concrete example/comparison or progress precedes further intake
No more than three actual clarification questions per reply; partial answers allowed
No displayed mode/tier/runtime/path citations or unexplained all-in jargon
No fabricated live properties, availability, rents, legal claims or completed tool actions
Choice controls accept selected and free-text answers without preselection; exact private input is saved once
Interruption is answered directly, and prior preferences remain available without restarting intake
Raw provider receipts and complete usage survive formatting and exports
evidence_limits: Same model family simulates persona and answers. Host uses text-only CLI with a local structured-choice adapter, not Codex native clarification transport. Root AI evaluates observed replies; user review remains decisive. No actual property search in this lab.
